headline: Saudi coalition intercepts second drone over southern region
dek: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone launched from Yemen toward Saudi Arabia's southern region (area unspecified); no Ansar Allah comment at the time. This follows the eastern-region intercept already recorded as 0000-01 and a 2 Nov claim of a ballistic missile + two drones…
sources: Saudi-led coalition spokesman Maj-Gen Turki al-Maliki statement via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Two Saudi intercepts in one evening (east + south): contained Ansar Allah pressure campaign or the prelude to a wider Red Sea/Gulf escalation?
